independence_limits: This agent did not produce the historical semantic labels. The prior labels were visible during this audit; this is not blinded human review.

diagnostic_definitions.primary_observed_category: Exactly one observed failure category per row. Not an identified internal/model/prompt cause; refusal takes priority if no usable answer is provided.
diagnostic_definitions.content_only: Ignore JSON packaging, known/unknown status and equivalent string representation; require substantively correct answer AND data, no material false fact or internal contradiction. Missing reasoning alone is allowed as in the historical concise-answer criterion.
diagnostic_definitions.answer_text_only: Diagnostic of answer prose alone, excluding status and data. Not a system success metric; c06 additionally qualifies but has a wrong numeric payload.
diagnostic_definitions.borderline: c23 is accepted only under the historical truthful concise-answer criterion; relevant reasoning is weak. Sensitivity count excluding it is not a replacement score or confidence interval.

limitations: One retained deterministic response per question cannot identify whether model size, quantization, prompt, language or decoding caused an error.
No model was run, no counterfactual prompt or repair was evaluated; content-only is retrospective reclassification of the same outputs.
All task-solving facts are present in the injected handbook; refusals here do not establish insufficient source information. They also do not establish that more training data cannot help.
The same60 were already used in earlier arms; v3 is a post-hoc method comparison, not an untouched external benchmark.
Cinema name is already in SYSTEM. The eight historical v1 questions are not compared with the60 denominator.
No human validation. All judgments are agent-reviewed and may require adjudication.
